chronology_coverage_note: Susa, Gobekli Tepe, Stonehenge/Avebury and Jomon have supported phase bounds earlier than 3400 BCE, the historical boundary layer coverage floor. Dates are not truncated to fit the map; period/approximate/unknown stages do not provide an exact automatic year.

identity_policy.keys: Original Pleiades IDs preserved; global records keyed by distinct Wikidata QIDs.
identity_policy.note: Different source identities and nonidentical names do not imply disjoint spatial coverage. Serial properties, historic cities and whole archaeological areas can encompass or neighbour individual Pleiades features. Representative points are locators, not boundaries.
